newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE army signs $50.5 million in deals.
newsitem.headline: UAE army signs $50.5 million in deals.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates army said on Wednesday it signed deals worth $50.5 million with local and foreign firms, including one for naval torpedoes.
The deals, announced during the Gulf Arab state's IDEX 97 arms show, included a $29.5 million deal with France's Eurotorp to supply naval torpedoes, the army said in a statement.
It signed an $8 million contract with Norway's Kongsberg Norcontrol Systems AS for a tactical training simulator for the navy, it said.
The Abu Dhabi National Hotels Company was awarded a two-year contract worth 49 million dirhams ($12 million) to manage the central officers army club, it added.
The higher colleges of technology clinched a 3.5 million dirham ($1 million) deal to conduct training courses for surveying and mapping.
